scope: WASM substrate and the extension CSP only. NOT ORT Web. S-03 separate.

headline: Chrome MV3 blocks WebAssembly.compile() under the DEFAULT extension CSP in the service worker, the offscreen document, AND the dedicated worker inside it.
Identical on WSL2 Linux and on native Windows, headful and headless - a Chrome MV3 behaviour, not an environment artefact.
Declaring 'wasm-unsafe-eval' unblocks it completely: scalar and SIMD element-exact, 0 mismatches, everywhere.
Chrome's error names 'wasm-eval' as an alternative - NARROWER than 'unsafe-eval'. UNTESTED. Filed S-02a-2b-1 (p0), blocking the S-02a-2a ADR.
ASYMMETRY: SharedArrayBuffer is TRUE in Chrome extension contexts and FALSE in Firefox. WASM threads available on Chrome, unavailable on Firefox.
The WASM CSP restriction is CROSS-BROWSER, so S-02a-2a is a project-wide p0 rather than a Firefox workaround.
